COGNITO_CLIENT_ID: the S4R app client AC admin sign-in uses until Phase 7 (ownership.md, ADR 0006). An environment value of the AC function, imported unchanged; the client is S4R and never managed.
S4R_PRODUCT_BASE_URL: buy links point to the S4R shop CloudFront (ownership.md). An environment value of the AC function, imported unchanged; the distribution is S4R and never managed.
The diagnosis Lambda runs under the S4R server role (ADR 0011). The function references the role ARN unchanged; the role is never imported or modified.
The same role, by ARN, as the function's Role property.
Only inside the S4R role name above (the role name starts with the S4R stack name). import.sh stops 5.10 if it occurs anywhere else in the template.
